target: count - anchor; anchor is weekly template count when available, otherwise latest own observed count
training: one shared dataset per outer date-held-out fold; released train plus released test, excluding entire assessment date
selection: two date-held-out development folds on September 4/5 only; median best round, no configuration search
template: lam=.8; earlier train dates of same weekday, prefer long; coefficients from other eligible long train recordings; exclude own date and outer assessment date
availability: same-camera last observation within 5 minutes; otherwise unchanged isolated T05 fallback
im: unsupported, retain current predictor; no trained I-M history
